title: Limits on shops and trials, and narrowed database rights
decision: A person may own at most five shops that are not erased and gets one trial; a later shop starts in limited mode until paid; signed sign-in data is remembered for one hour and five minutes; sessions are deleted when they expire or are revoked and administrator request keys after 30 days; reading the card number stays an ordinary read because every owner sees it to pay; separate database roles for the administrators' side and the worker were not introduced
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 63
rationale: The review named the gaps; the documents give no limit on shops and no retention for sessions
